snippet.title: Yuletide Regicide | Game Trailer (2025)
snippet.description:
Yuletide Regicide – a free Christmas game to get you into the festive spirit... Or else!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4129000/Yuletide_Regicide/

A dead Santa Claus right before Christmas is never a good sign... Interrogate the North Pole suspects to solve the murder and figure out how to save the festive season in this short dark comedy visual novel / interactive cartoon whodunnit. A story full of weird humor, conspiracies, murder, and all that usual Christmas fun!

Linux / Mac versions also available on Itch.io:
https://bestgames.itch.io/yuletide-regicide
